title: Minesweeper
prompt:
Build Minesweeper on a 9x9 board with 10 mines. Mines are placed (seeded) at the first reveal so that the revealed cell and its 8 neighbours are mine-free. Revealing a cell with no adjacent mines also reveals its neighbours (flood fill). Revealing a mine ends the game with won false; revealing every safe cell ends it with won true. Flagged cells cannot be revealed. score = revealed safe cells. Mouse: left click reveals, right click flags. Touch: a tap reveals; a press held at least 400 ms (real time) toggles a flag instead.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, won, cols:9, rows:9, mines, flags, revealed, cells (cells[y][x] = {revealed, flagged, adjacent: number when revealed, else null})}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.reveal(x, y): returns false when nothing happens
- Game.input.flag(x, y): toggle a flag on a hidden cell
- Game.cellCenter(x, y): canvas point of a cell
- Game.debug.setMines(list): before the first reveal, place exactly these mines [[x,y],...] (no relocation; mines = list length)

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): safe first reveal, flood fill, numbers, win, loss, flags, seeded boards, click, tap and long-press.
